sentence: This project studies how the structure and genes of maize stalks affect their strength, using breeding, mechanical tests and computational models.
This project builds statistical and machine learning tools that combine medical imaging, genetic data and clinical measurements to guide treatment for each patient.
This project studies how marine heatwaves affect the embryos and larvae of red and purple sea urchins in kelp forests.
This project builds deep learning tools that forecast how things change across space and time while following physical laws.
This project builds machine learning tools that filter out radio interference in measurements made by radio telescopes.
This project studies how warming oceans, ocean acidification and the loss of foundation species change how rocky intertidal communities work.
This project builds a way to automatically judge the visual quality of three-dimensional videos that many people share in virtual reality.
This project studies how insects and spiders in the Hawaiian Islands change as forests are invaded by non-native plants, using DNA and remote sensing.
This project studies how RNA interference and chromatin modifying pathways work together to keep genes properly regulated in germ cells during heat stress.
This project compares two ways of restoring mined land in Wyoming and how each affects soil, water, plants and cost.
This project studies how pores form in printed metal parts and whether they cause cracks when the polymer binder is heated.
This project builds computer tools that watch videos of individual bees to study how pollinators behave.
This project builds a machine learning method that learns from data even when some kinds of information are missing.
This project tests a magnetic gear actuator for robots in space, including how it performs in microgravity.
This project builds a way to isolate T-cells that react to diseased cells and turn their receptors into a form usable as drugs.
This project builds computer vision methods that help robots see, map and plan around objects in space despite harsh lighting.
This project studies whether self-reactive T cells help the uterus break down and rebuild its lining.
This project builds computer methods that combine medical records, scans, laboratory tests and genetic data to predict disease and guide treatment.
This project uses gene editing to improve crops and tests plant-derived antibiotics against drug resistant infections.
